description:
Create a broadcast.

Creates a draft. The `from` address must belong to a verified domain of your team and `audience_id` to one of your audiences.

Requires a `full_access` API key. API: `POST /broadcasts` (operationId `createBroadcast`, Broadcasts).

from.description: An email address, optionally with a display name: `Acme <hello@acme.com>`. At most 998 characters, display name included. A display name can't contain `<`, `>` or an encoded word, and a `from` name can only show an email address on one of your verified domains.
